title: text get

messages.description: specify message number and output (0 for first message)
starting element number (-1 for the whole message
pointer to the text if -s flag is used
a message from text or elements from it
0 for a semicolon, 1 for a comma, 2 if out of range

arguments.description: text name if no flags are given

flags.name: -s <symbol, symbol>
flags.description: struct name and field name of main structure

body: [text get] outputs a line of a text, given its number (0 for the first), or a range of its elements. The right outlet sends 0 if the line ended with a semicolon, 1 for a comma, or 2 if the number is out of range. The text is named by the argument or the right inlet, or found through a pointer with -s.
